product.title: Cuffed D-Ring Lifting Straps
product.descriptionHtml:
Your grip should never be the reason a set ends.

The One Percent Standard Cuffed D-Ring Lifting Straps lock around your wrist with a neoprene cuff, so the load sits on the strap, not your fingers. Deadlifts, rows, shrugs and pulls: keep the bar moving long after your grip would have quit.

  • Neoprene wrist cuff. Soft, breathable and non-slip. Spreads the load and stays put between sets.
  • Hook and loop closure. Wrap, fasten, lift. Adjusts to fit most wrists.
  • D-ring anchored strap. 30cm strap rides on the D-ring, so it wraps the bar clean and holds.
  • One size, sold as a pair.

Built for people who train like the last one percent is the part that counts.
